Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that there will be about 75,300 interpreters and translators on the job in 2024, and it is expected to rise to 76,600 by 2034, with a net increase of about 1,300 positions, an average annual vacancy of about 6,900, and a median annual salary of about US$59,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).

AI will not replace interpreters and translators, but it will reshape the workflow of interpreters and translators: handing over repetitive and structurable tasks to tools, people will focus on judgment, responsibility and creativity. subject.summary: Interpreters and Translators (Interpreters And Translators) are professions that carry professional judgment and responsibility on their shoulders: AI accelerates structured tasks, but the core decision-making is still completed by humans.
